Claim 1 (Currently Amended): A process for obtaining a valued material from an aqueous suspension, dispersion or solution containing the valued material comprising adding to the aqueous suspension, dispersion or solution a Maillard reaction product, the Maillard reaction product comprising an adduct of (1) an amine reactant __selected from the group consisting of ammonia, ammonium hydroxide, hydrazine, guanidine, primary amines, secondary amines, quaternary ammonium compounds, polyamines, amino acids, and proteins__ and (2) a reducing sugar __selected from the group consisting of dextrose, fructose, high fructose corn syrup, erythrulose, ribulose, xylulose, psicose, sorbose, tagatose, glyceraldehyde, erythrose, threose, ribose, arabinose, xylose, allose, altrose, mannose, gulose, galactose, talose, maltose, and lactose__, a reducing sugar equivalent, or a mixture thereof.

Claim 3 (Currently Amended): The process of claim 1, wherein the amine reactant contains at least one amine functional group, and wherein a molar ratio of the reducing sugar, the reducing sugar equivalent, or the mixture thereof to the amine functional group is about __2:1 to__ about 3:1.

Claim 4 (Currently Amended): The process of claim 1, wherein the reducing sugar, the reducing sugar equivalent, or the mixture thereof is selected from the group consisting of: dextrose, fructose, high fructose corn syrup, erythrulose, ribulose, xylulose, psicose, sorbose, tagatose, glyceraldehyde, erythrose, threose, ribose, arabinose, xylose, allose, altrose, mannose, gulose, galactose, talose, maltose, lactose, __pyruvaldehyde, acetaldehyde, crotonaldehyde, 2-furaldehyde, glycolaldehyde, glycolaldehyde dimer, trans-3-(2-furyl)acrolein, acrolein, 5-hydroxymethylfurfural, 5-methylfurfural, 4-hydroxycrotonaldehyde, and cinnamaldehyde__, [[furfural, pyruvaldehyde, acetaldehyde, crotonaldehyde, 2- furaldehyde, glycolaldehyde, glycolaldehyde dimer, trans-3-(2-furyl)acrolein, acrolein, 5- hydroxymethylfurfural, 5-methylfurfural, 4-hydroxycrotonaldehyde, and cinnamaldehyde,]] and wherein the amine reactant is selected from the group consisting of: ammonia, ammonium hydroxide, hydrazine, guanidine, primary amines, secondary amines, quaternary ammonium compounds, polyamines, amino acids, and proteins.

Claim 5 (Currently Amended): The process of claim 1, wherein the Maillard reaction product has a __sulfur functionality, a phosphorus functionality, a sulfate functionality, a sulfonate functionality, a hydroxamic acid functionality, a silane functionality, a phenolic functionality, or an aza crown chelating functionality__ [[cationic functionality, a sulfur functionality, a phosphorus functionality, a sulfate functionality, a sulfonate functionality, a hydroxamic acid functionality, a silane functionality, a phenolic functionality, or an aza crown chelating functionality]].

Claim 6 (Currently Amended): The process of claim 1, wherein the Maillard reaction product is produced by reacting the amine reactant __selected from the group consisting of ammonia, ammonium hydroxide, hydrazine, guanidine, primary amines, secondary amines, quaternary ammonium compounds, polyamines, amino acids, and proteins__ and the reducing sugar __selected from the group consisting of dextrose, fructose, high fructose corn syrup, erythrulose, ribulose, xylulose, psicose, sorbose, tagatose, glyceraldehyde, erythrose, threose, ribose, arabinose, xylose, allose, altrose, mannose, gulose, galactose, talose, maltose, and lactose__.

Claim 9 (Currently Amended): The process of claim 1, wherein the valued material is obtained by __filtration or__ sedimentation[[, filtration, or flotation]].

Claim 10 (Currently Amended): The process of claim 1, further comprising recovering the value material from the aqueous suspension, dispersion or solution after adding the Maillard reaction product thereto to produce a purified product, wherein the purified product contains a reduced concentration of at least one impurity relative to the aqueous suspension, dispersion, or solution, __and wherein the Maillard reaction product comprises an adduct of an amine reactant selected from the group consisting of ammonia, ammonium hydroxide, hydrazine, guanidine, primary amines, secondary amines, quaternary ammonium compounds, polyamines, amino acids, and proteins__.

Claim 11 (Currently Amended): The process of claim 1, wherein the Maillard reaction product __promotes flotation of__ [[depresses]] the value material or an impurity in the aqueous suspension, dispersion, or solution.

Claim 13 (Currently Amended): A process for separating a valued material from a suspension, dispersion, or solution, comprising: treating the liquid suspension, dispersion, or solution with a Maillard reaction product of (1) an amine __selected from the group consisting of ammonia, ammonium hydroxide, hydrazine, guanidine, primary amines, secondary amines, quaternary ammonium compounds, polyamines, amino acids, and proteins__ and (2) a reducing sugar __selected from the group consisting of dextrose, fructose, high fructose corn syrup, erythrulose, ribulose, xylulose, psicose, sorbose, tagatose, glyceraldehyde, erythrose, threose, ribose, arabinose, xylose, allose, altrose, mannose, gulose, galactose, talose, maltose, and lactose__, a reducing sugar equivalent, or a mixture thereof to provide a treated mixture; and removing a purified valued material from the treated mixture.

Claim 15 (Currently Amended): The process of claim 13, wherein the Maillard reaction product is produced by reacting the amine __selected from the group consisting of ammonia, ammonium hydroxide, hydrazine, guanidine, primary amines, secondary amines, quaternary ammonium compounds, polyamines, amino acids, and proteins__ and the reducing sugar __selected from the group consisting of dextrose, fructose, high fructose corn syrup, erythrulose, ribulose, xylulose, psicose, sorbose, tagatose, glyceraldehyde, erythrose, threose, ribose, arabinose, xylose, allose, altrose, mannose, gulose, galactose, talose, and lactose__.

Claim 16 (Currently Amended): The process of claim 13, wherein the amine contains at least one amine functional group, and wherein a molar ratio of the reducing sugar, the reducing sugar equivalent, or the mixture thereof to the amine functional group is about __2:1 to__ about 3:1.

Claim 17 (Currently Amended): The process of claim 13, wherein the reducing sugar, the reducing sugar equivalent, or the mixture thereof __is a monosaccharide that__ contains an aldehyde moiety reactive with Cu+2 to produce a carboxylic acid moiety.

Claim 18 (Currently Amended): The process of claim 13, wherein the reducing sugar, the reducing sugar equivalent, or the mixture thereof is selected from the group consisting of: dextrose, fructose, high fructose corn syrup, erythrulose, ribulose, xylulose, psicose, sorbose, tagatose, glyceraldehyde, erythrose, threose, ribose, arabinose, xylose, allose, altrose, mannose, gulose, galactose, talose, maltose, lactose, __pyruvaldehyde, acetaldehyde, crotonaldehyde, 2-furaldehyde, glycolaldehyde, glycolaldehyde dimer, trans-3-(2-furyl)acrolein, acrolein, 5-hydroxymethylfurfural, 5-methylfurfural, 4-hydroxycrotonaldehyde, and cinnamaldehyde__, [[furfural, pyruvaldehyde, acetaldehyde, crotonaldehyde, 2- furaldehyde, glycolaldehyde, glycolaldehyde dimer, trans-3-(2-furyl)acrolein, acrolein, 5- hydroxymethylfurfural, 5-methylfurfural, 4-hydroxycrotonaldehyde, and cinnamaldehyde,]] and wherein the amine is selected from the group consisting of: ammonia, ammonium hydroxide, hydrazine, guanidine, primary amines, secondary amines, quaternary ammonium compounds, polyamines, amino acids, and proteins.

Claim 19 (Currently Amended): The process of claim 13, wherein the Maillard reaction product __promotes flotation of__ [[depresses]] the value material or an impurity present in the treated mixture[[, or wherein the Maillard reaction product promotes flotation of the value material or the impurity in the treated mixture]].

Claim 20 (Currently Amended): The process of claim 13, wherein the purified valued material is removed from the treated mixture by __filtration or__ sedimentation[[, filtration, or flotation]].
